info.name: eZee Technosys YCS Connectivity Inventory and Rates PMS Connectivity API
PMS connectivity operations (bookings, inventory, rates, restrictions, configuration)

items.docs: Single JSON POST endpoint that multiplexes PMS connectivity operations via a RequestType field. Documented operations include: retrieving a booking, retrieving all bookings (new / modified / cancelled updates), retrieving transaction details, receiving a booking, updating room inventory, updating linear and non-linear rates, updating stay restrictions (StopSell, Close-on-Arrival, Close-on-Departure, Min Nights, Max Nights), retrieving room rates with source details, and retrieving room informati
